chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever begins [his meal] with salt, God will remove from him seventy illnesses, the least of which is leprosy.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of eating salt according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet (peace be upon him) highlights the prophetic practice of beginning meals with salt, promising protection from seventy ailments, with leprosy (*al-Judham*) cited as the least severe. This reflects the Shia emphasis on *Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine), where simple dietary habits are viewed as divine remedies for both physical and spiritual purification.
